entities.name: Hendrik II van Borselen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Henry II van Borselen, Lord of Veere, Zandenburg, Vlissingen, Westkapelle, Domburg, Brouwershaven, Count of Grandpré was a Dutch noble and 
admiral of the 15th Century.
